# mvstmt: extract an expression to a function
mv x.go:/x \+ y/ NewFunc
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x, y int) int {
	return x + y
}
-- stderr --
x.go:8:13: undefined: y
errors found after executing: mv x.go:/x \+ y/ NewFunc
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,9 @@
 package m

 func F(x, y int) int {
+	return NewFunc(x)
+}
+
+func NewFunc(x int) int {
 	return x + y
 }
